full_name: David Hibbett | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Medicine Grass Fellow Clark University
bio: David Hibbett is an evolutionary biologist specializing in the study of fungi (mycology), particularly mushrooms. His current research emphasizes genomics and molecular evolution but also draws on morphology, developmental biology, and paleomycology. He is a professor of biology at Clark University, in Worcester, Massachusetts.
